name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.9.1-dev.2 (19 Nov): release candidate for the 0.9.1 playtest. Long-range SAMs (Patriot, Buk, IRIS-T, S-300/350/400, HQ-9/9A/9B/16/11/12/6A) see 5300 m at low and high altitude; China Infantry 步兵 35 points; loading screens 24 -> 12 (five new China vehicle scenes); our third-party mod DLLs now carry an FA prefix (build code changes once). Includes everything in 0.9.1-dev.1. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.47.
